status: diagnostic ablations; not the final qualification
notes: All runs use public code/prose prompts, greedy seed 1234, 256 tokens, context 4096, cache off.
Generic old/live-price labels mean the frozen published drafter baseline and the private experiment.
The overhead isolation uses the same frozen binary with suffix, literal draft:false oracle, attached-but-disabled oracle and drafted arms.
Phase-profile is instrumented and diagnostic; its rates are not release evidence.
Timed-holds-v2/v3 were explicitly interrupted and are not recorded as completed qualification.
M4 hold-accounting was interrupted after its controls drifted under unrelated CPU/memory load.

descriptions.hold-accounting: Models outgoing batched heads from the timed shape rather than per-step multiplication.
descriptions.overhead-isolation: Same binary: suffix, literal draft:false oracle, drafter attached but disabled, and active drafting.
descriptions.phase-profile: Instrumented host-absorb and GPU-hold phase counters, including warmups.
descriptions.copy-depth: Conditional acceptance by copied position, learned separately by source.
descriptions.shared-marginals: Shared increments anchored to the original 16-row window cost.
descriptions.measured-prices: Shared increments plus outgoing hold-shape overhead accounting.
descriptions.marginals-plain-pair: Same calibrated binary with and without the external drafter.
descriptions.calibrated-copies: Shared increments with the ordinary fixed copy prior restored.
descriptions.calibrated-gain: Shared increments, ordinary copy policy, and gain scaled relative to the acceptance prior.
descriptions.matched-copies: Shared increments with the fixed prior retained for long suffix matches.
descriptions.bounded-confidence: A deeper pending hold falls back entirely when cached confidence is too short.
descriptions.timed-holds: Uniform late-hold budgeting; pending work inferred from selected streams.
descriptions.timed-holds-v2: Uniform budgeting with a drafter-owned pending-cost query; interrupted.
descriptions.timed-holds-v3: Pending-cost metadata and one proposer query; interrupted.

phase_profile_totals.note: Hold GPU time also includes staged-context ingestion; these counters are not a pure context-versus-drafting decomposition.
